description:
This protocol automates a multi-wash virus isolation using magnetic beads and a magnetic module GEN2. It contains custom shakes in between transfers to release any droplets on the end of the pipette tips.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons P300 GEN2 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips
USA Scientific 12-Well Reservoir, 22ml
Opentrons Magnetic Module (GEN2)
NEST 96 Well Plate 2000 µL
